question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Many Americans appear to be ________ those warnings seriously.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(4) i.e.** 'Taking'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** taking** means to carry or posses something.**(लेना)**

 
 
• **Example:-** I take bath daily.
 
 
 
• The rest options are not suitable for the given blank.

Therefore, the correct option is** (4).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options are-
 
 
• **Understanding- **The knowledge that somebody has of a particular subject or situation.**(समझ)**
 
• **Sacking- **An act of removing someone/something.**(हिलना)**
 
• **Making- **An act of doing or producing something, the process of being made.**(बनाना)**
